title: Hou Juncheng: “Proya is moving closer to European suppliers and expertise”
summary: Located in Suresnes, near Paris, France, Proya's newly established 450 m² R&D laboratory already employs seven scientists. Premium Beauty News spoke with Hou Juncheng, founder and president of Proya Cosmetics, about the ambitions behind this new facility. Having generated US$1.5 billion in revenue in 2025, the Chinese cosmetics group is looking to further accelerate its international expansion.
